items.author: trashochist.bsky.social
items.context: My steam deck is a slow burn for me cause when i first got it im like, man why did i buy this again? I dont go out often, i could just play games in my PC. But now im unable to play games that is not on my steam deck, which means i can only play cozy/simple roguelikes games
items.text: That's the Deck's sweet spot, honestly. Cozy and simple roguelikes fit it well because you can put it to sleep mid-run and pick up right where you left off.

items.author: spookyomo.bsky.social
items.context: Do i start a new stardew save to stave off my boredom? Mmmm yes i think so. Now what farm do i go with?
items.text: A fresh save is a great cure for boredom. If you want something different from the standard farm, Forest is lovely for foraging and Riverland suits anyone who likes fishing.
